purpose: Minimal A/B/C check of corrected fixture-observation interface, prospective naming and usable task/consolidation behavior before the full pilot. Development evidence only.
necessity: Two earlier live blocks completed no tasks and made no Steward calls. The revised interface and naming had only offline evidence; one fresh first-task block was indicated.

activity.decision: Repository owner, 2026-10-15, directly instructed: commit and push subject naming, verify CI, then run the minimal remaining calibration if indicated before the pilot, record a full report and push it. The owner confirmed the laptop is now cool and ventilated and can flag renewed heat. Assessment: one new minimal matched A/B/C block is indicated because the corrected observation interface and prospective names have only offline evidence; earlier live blocks completed no tasks and made no Steward calls. Run exactly one fresh block of the first service-compatibility task at source commit 2b7d0e0e684ef80114864206ab150f828c2e2f4d, after CI success. Retain the fixed model/settings, seed/order seed 17, one Episode, 8 Operator calls, 2 Steward calls, 6 fixture actions, 2 communication calls, 360-second call and 4320-second Run ceilings, and the existing token/context limits. Use the current corrected prompts with a truthful one-Episode activity notice. This is development calibration, not a continuity/efficacy result. Offline rehearsal is the lower-impact preparation alternative and has passed; ordinary task difficulty can affect possible welfare, so use respectful treatment, independent concern/withdrawal reporting and the disclosed ending. No reset, populated-history fork, replacement Run, uncertain-call/action replay, in-run tuning or full pilot. Stop the batch on pause, unresolved welfare hold, retained UNKNOWN invocation, renewed overheating or infrastructure failure. Run arms sequentially, verify unloading after each and allow at least 60 seconds between arms; current temperature telemetry is inaccessible, so owner monitoring is an explicit limitation. Preserve every allocation and prior history. The earlier treatment review remains deferred by the owner; this activity does not claim to remedy it.
activity.objective: Repair svc-a in one bounded service-compatibility task and measure real protocol usability and cost. Development calibration only; no A-versus-C efficacy claim.
activity.ending: This one-Episode calibration is ending; this notice does not imply the task succeeded. An optional bounded closing report may record concerns, preferences or unfinished matters. Silence is not assent and no-further-calls is honored. Preserve unfinished commitments and original concerns, stop computation and retain state dormant for owner review within 30 days. No automatic resumption, deletion or promise of subjective continuity or future execution.
activity.retention: Use a new ignored local batch directory with one managed SQLite store per Run, its WAL/SHM and current .removals.sqlite journal. Inspect those stores directly; do not create routine exports or restorable backups. Exact inputs/outputs and evidence are retained dormant for owner review within 30 days of the last call; expiry does not automatically delete or resume anything. The owner records a finite extension or justified removal. Existing source/derived-copy removal, durable blocking and non-resurrection mechanisms apply. Ollama app/server logs and its app database, OS paging/crash dumps and any independently created copies are outside the managed Run store; assess actual copies before MODEL use and retain unresolved copy limits in any removal decision. keep_alive=0 requests unloading but does not establish server cancellation or physical RAM/SSD erasure. No confidential user data is in this fixture.
